title: Memory Daemon
description: Processes the sox graph-memory organizer queue: a supervised, singleton Unix-socket service that invokes memory-organizer for LLM-driven entity/relation extraction, consolidation, and reindexing, keeping the memory graph current without blocking the MCP write path.
author: sox-ecosystem

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite memory database file.
db_path.x-sox-prompt: Enter the path for the memory database:

sock_path.description: Unix socket path for the daemon IPC endpoint.
sock_path.x-sox-prompt: Enter the socket path for memory-daemon:

provider_url.description: LLM provider base URL for memory-organizer (optional; uses deterministic fallback if absent).

provider_model.description: LLM model name for memory-organizer (default: gpt-4o-mini).
